name: Checkbox Card
description: A checkbox rendered as a selectable card with a title, description, and optional icon; works standalone or stacked in groups.
usage:
<CheckboxCard
  title="Email digest"
  description="A weekly summary of activity"
  defaultChecked
  onCheckedChange={(checked) => console.log(checked)}
/>

anatomy.description: A button with checkbox semantics (role and aria-checked) that owns the whole click target.
A decorative corner check that mirrors the state; assistive technology reads aria-checked instead.
The card's accessible name and primary label.
Supporting text and an optional icon that explain what the toggle does.

dos: Give every card a specific title that states what turns on or off.
Stack related opt-ins, such as notification channels, as a group of cards.
Keep unavailable options visible but disabled.
donts: Don't use cards for mutually exclusive choices; use RadioCard.
Don't use a card when a plain Checkbox with a label says enough.

examples.title: Standalone card
examples.description: One self-contained toggle with a visible check indicator in the corner.

examples.title: Stacked group
examples.description: Several independent cards, including icons and a disabled unavailable option.

guidance.useWhen: An on/off choice needs a description or icon to be understood, such as notification channels or feature opt-ins.
guidance.avoidWhen: The choice needs no explanation; a plain Checkbox is more compact. Mutually exclusive options call for RadioCard.
guidance.behavior: Clicking or pressing Space toggles the card and reports the new checked state; each card in a group tracks its own state. Supports controlled and uncontrolled checked.
guidance.responsive: Cards fill their container width; stack them single-column on narrow screens.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from each card.

notes: The card is a button with checkbox semantics (aria-checked); the title doubles as its accessible name.
The check indicator is decorative; state is conveyed through aria-checked, not the icon.
